ThingDef.label: archite vector (perfect vision)
ThingDef.description: A sealed capsule of archite matter, cool and very light. It is the least of the things the archons have left lying about, and it is still beyond anything your people can make.\n\nThis one will remake the recipient's eyes.

ThingDef.label: archite vector (disease-free)
ThingDef.description: A sealed capsule of archite matter. Held to the light it is not quite empty, and what moves inside it moves against the tilt of your hand.\n\nThis one will close the recipient to every sickness this world has.

ThingDef.label: archite vector (masterful construction)
ThingDef.description: A sealed capsule of archite matter, heavier than its size argues for. The bone-house it came from was built by people who were very good at building, right up until they stopped.\n\nThis one will teach the recipient's hands what their mind cannot.

ThingDef.label: archite vector (masterful medicine)
ThingDef.description: A sealed capsule of archite matter. Whoever sorted the bones understood anatomy far better than they should have, and this is presumably why.\n\nThis one will make the recipient's hands steady inside another person.

ThingDef.label: archite vector (unbroken cultivation)
ThingDef.description: A sealed capsule of archite matter, and the only one so far that is warm rather than cool. The hermit held it for a long moment before handing it over, the way you hold something you have decided not to use.\n\nThis one opens the recipient to the energy the universe actually runs on, and does not close again.

ThingDef.label: archite vector (masterful presence)
ThingDef.description: A sealed capsule of archite matter, thrown in at the end of the deal without comment, as though the yard boss had decided something about you and did not intend to discuss it.\n\nThis one will make the recipient impossible to dismiss.

ThingDef.label: archite vector (herculean frame)
ThingDef.description: A sealed capsule of archite matter, recovered from silt in a flooded undercroft where an altar exactly like yours lies cracked across the middle. Nobody spent this one. You should wonder why.\n\nThis one will build the recipient into something that has to duck through doors.

ThingDef.label: archite vector (blur)
ThingDef.description: A sealed capsule of archite matter. Cold, even out of the water.\n\nThis one will make the recipient hard to watch and harder to catch.

ThingDef.label: archite vector (masterful blade)
ThingDef.description: A sealed capsule of archite matter, taken off the body of the last man in the hall who was still standing. Three families held this place on the strength of it and none of them ever opened it.\n\nThis one will make the recipient's hands know a weapon better than the smith who made it.

ThingDef.label: archite vector (masterful aim)
ThingDef.description: A sealed capsule of archite matter from the same hall, in a box that had not been opened in two centuries and was still oiled.\n\nThis one will put the recipient's shot where their eye already was.

ThingDef.label: archite vector (perfect immunity)
ThingDef.description: A sealed capsule of archite matter, shelved in a records vault beside eleven hundred years of accounts. It is catalogued. It has a number. Somebody filed it and went home.\n\nThis one will make the recipient's body win every argument it is ever offered.

ThingDef.label: archite vector (vacuum-proof)
ThingDef.description: A sealed capsule of archite matter, left on a launch pad by something that departed in a hurry and did not come back.\n\nThis one will let the recipient stand in nothing at all and keep breathing out of habit rather than need.

ThingDef.label: archite vector (leapjump legs)
ThingDef.description: A sealed capsule of archite matter, sold to you out of a breaker-yard by people who did not ask what you were and did not care.\n\nThis one will let the recipient cross a gap that has no floor in it.

ThingDef.label: archite vector (reimplanter)
ThingDef.description:
A sealed capsule of archite matter, found in a buried laboratory beside forty machines exactly like the one in your colony, each wired to a bench with a chair beside it.

They were not worshipping it. They were operating it. The manual was never about the machine. It was about who is allowed in the chair.

This one will let the recipient give away what they are. Not what they were chosen for = that stays.

ThingDef.label: archite vector (plasteel skin)
ThingDef.description: A sealed capsule of archite matter, still warm. Whatever is written inside it is not a substance so much as an instruction, and the instruction is legible only to the altar.\n\nThis one will lace the recipient's skin with plasteel.

ThingDef.label: archite vector (levitation)
ThingDef.description: A sealed capsule of archite matter, taken off a ring that was built to keep things like you inside this system.\n\nThis one will stop the ground mattering to the recipient.

ThingDef.label: archite vector (deep cultivation)
ThingDef.description: A sealed capsule of archite matter. It hums, faintly, in a register that is not sound, and the pawns carrying it will not carry it twice.\n\nThis one takes the recipient much further into the energy the universe runs on than a human nervous system was ever meant to go. That is not overheating. That is processing more than neurons can carry.

ThingDef.label: archite vector (transcendent)
ThingDef.description:
A sealed capsule of archite matter, handed to you personally, which has never happened before and will not happen again.

There is no ruin attached to this one. No pit, no vault, no ring. They simply held it out, and waited, and did not explain.

This one is the last thing They have to give.

ThingDef.label: archite vector (deathless)
ThingDef.description:
A sealed capsule of archite matter, and the weight of it is wrong in a way you stop being able to describe after the first minute.

Whatever is in here does not stop a wound. It refuses the conclusion of one.

It cannot be passed on. Nothing you do afterwards will let you give this away.
